config.ultimate_location_music.title: ULTIMATE LOCATION MUSIC
config.ultimate_location_music.enabled.t: Master toggle. Turn off to disable all location music.
config.ultimate_location_music.override_: Allow Location Music to play even if Minecraft's ambient music is playing.
config.ultimate_location_music.fluid_pit: Pitch when inside Water or Lava. 75 = lower/deeper tone.
Gradually fade music in and out instead of cutting abruptly.
config.ultimate_location_music.fade_in_t: How long the fade-in takes. 20 ticks = 1 second.
config.ultimate_location_music.fade_out_: How long the fade-out takes before entering ghost state.
config.ultimate_location_music.ghost_tic: How long a faded-out track lingers silently before it can be restarted from the beginning.
config.ultimate_location_music.add_locat: Adds a new location zone. Save to confirm.
Display name for this location zone.
Whether the track loops while inside the zone.
The dimension this zone applies to, e.g. minecraft:overworld.
Width centre position of the area
Snaps X to your current position on save.
Height centre position of the area
Snaps Y to your current position on save.
Depth centre position of the area
Snaps Z to your current position on save.
Width distance from the centre where music stops
Height distance from the centre where music stops
Depth distance from the centre where music stops
Which song to play (1–32, maps to location_1 … location_32 in sounds.json).
Removes this location zone. Save to confirm.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.ultimate_: Plays custom music when you enter a specific area.
